home.intro: This is the starting point of the app.

about.tagline: Desktop app built with Tauri and Fluent UI.

llm.tokenHint: Generate one with `claude setup-token`. It is kept in the OS credential store.
llm.tokenDesktopOnly: Only available in the desktop app.
llm.tokenError: Could not access the credential store: {{error}}

images.intro: The systems agents run on. The base image is built in; add your own with a script that runs on top of it or on another of your images. An agent profile picks the image.
images.baseDescription: Alpine with agentd, Claude Code and ripgrep. Built by the app, it cannot be edited. Rebuilt after an app update that changes it.
images.scriptHint: Runs once as root when the image is built, on top of the image it is based on (Alpine; apk is available). Saving builds the image; editing it later makes it out of date until you rebuild.
images.needBase: Build the image it is based on first.
images.parentHint: The image the script runs on. Rebuilding it makes this one out of date.
images.envHint: Built into the image, for every agent that runs on it (and on images built on this one). Saved in plain text in the image, so do not put secrets here.

updates.title: Updates
updates.managed: Version {{version}} is available. This install is managed by your package manager.
updates.ready: Version {{version}} was installed. Restart to use it.

profiles.title: Agent profiles
profiles.empty: No agent profiles yet. Create one to define how an agent is set up.
profiles.desktopOnly: Only available in the desktop app.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.systemPromptHint: Added to Claude's system prompt for every task of this agent.
profiles.envHint: Sent to the agent with every task.
profiles.imageHint: The system this agent runs on. Images are managed in Settings.
profiles.modelHint: A Claude model alias (sonnet, opus, haiku) or a full model id. Empty uses Claude Code's default.
profiles.effortHint: How much the agent thinks before answering. Higher is slower and costs more.
profiles.cpusHint: Virtual CPUs of the VM. Empty gives it all the host's cores. This limits how many cores it can use, not their share of time.
profiles.memoryHint: RAM of the VM, at least 1024. Default 2048.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.text: Set up a starting point? This creates two images, Developer (git, GitHub CLI, Python, Node.js) and Manual QA (headless Chromium with playwright-cli), built on the base image in the background, five agent profiles (orchestrator, project manager, business analyst, developer, tester), and a Demo project with the standard delivery workflow: the orchestrator plans, the project manager and business analyst shape the work, you approve the requirements, the developer builds and the tester verifies. You can edit or delete all of it later.
welcome.done: Starter images and profiles created. The images are building.

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create one to design its workflow and start sessions.
projects.desktopOnly: Available in the desktop app only.
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}" with its workflow and sessions? This cannot be undone.
projects.name: Name
projects.systemPromptHint: Added to the system prompt of every agent in this project, before the agent profile's own.

sessions.empty: No sessions yet. A session is one run of the project's workflow for a task you describe.
sessions.notRunnable: Running sessions is not available yet.
sessions.name: Name
sessions.taskHint: What the workflow should deliver. It is the first input of the first step.
sessions.hint: Open a session to run its workflow.

wf.pick: Select a step to edit it. Drag from a step's right handle to another step to connect them.
wf.label: Label
wf.agentPromptHint: Added to the task of this step, after the output of the previous steps.
wf.schemaHint: Makes the result structured so conditions can read it.
wf.maxRunsHint: How many times a session may reach this step before it fails (loops).
wf.fieldHint: `status` or `result.<key>` of the previous agent's result.

mode.label: Kind
mode.hint: Changing it removes the step's outgoing connections.

wf.humanPromptHint: Shown to the user when the session waits here.

problem.unreachable: "{{node}}" cannot be reached from the start.
problem.unknown_profile: "{{node}}" uses an agent profile that does not exist.
problem.missing_branch: "{{node}}" is missing one of its exits.
problem.duplicate_branch: "{{node}}" has two connections on the same exit.
problem.no_end: The workflow has no end step.

wf.instancesHint: How many agents of this profile work on the step at once. The engine picks a number in this range and splits the work between them.
wf.coordinatorHint: The coordinator receives the result of every step and decides which of the connected steps comes next, within the connections drawn here. Without one, results flow along the connections.
wf.timeoutHint: How long an agent run of this step may take before it is killed. Default 30.

runs.title: Run an agent
runs.hint: Starts one agent of a profile in its own VM, on the profile's image, with your Claude token (Settings > LLM). The log is kept in the app data folder.
